caption: The drawing contains two main objects on a beige background. On the left side, there is a colored depiction of a decorated moccasin. The moccasin is adorned with geometric beadwork in blue, pink, yellow, and white, with blue pom-poms attached to its toe area. The inner lining and trim of the moccasin are shaded with pink and yellow. The design is bordered and accented with smaller, repetitive patterns of blue rectangles and pink squares. On the right side, there is an open book with two visible pages, illustrated in brown and beige tones to represent bark or wood. The book has three visible bindings or cords holding the pages together and is filled with lines of symbols or glyphs in black ink or pencil. There is light shading behind each object, suggesting depth. Beneath both objects are handwritten notations describing the objects, their origins, and their materials, written in pencil. At the top edge of the paper, there is a row of evenly spaced perforations.
title: Moccasin and Writing Book
